text: Sometimes, even when you're doing everything right, life throws you a rough patch. And it's okay. You can be working on yourself, building your career, staying fit, having hobbies, and putting in a lot of effort with women. Using dating apps, approaching girls on the weekends, meeting them in real life through classes or social clubs. But sometimes, things just aren't going your way. One girl ghosted you after what seemed to be a great date. Another unmatched you on Bumble just when you thought things were going well. That other girl you met in a class? She's out of town for weeks. And in that moment, your spirits drop. You start thinking. I'm trying so hard. Where are the results? Why is it just not working out? And here's the answer. Patience, my friend. Sometimes, life gives you a rough patch. Everything seems to go wrong at once. But that doesn't mean you are failing. On the bright side, you are still becoming a better version of yourself. You are approaching girls, asking them out, trying new things. Compare yourself to who you were a year ago. You are already miles ahead. When it comes to women, don't give up. A dry spell is just a period. If you keep doing the right things, results will come. All those no's today will be balanced out by the yeses tomorrow. And if you really feel down, take a break. Buy yourself something nice, go on a short trip, treat yourself to good food. It is okay to recharge. But always come back stronger, with more energy. Remember, dating and self-growth are a marathon, not a sprint. Be patient, trust the process, and keep moving forward. The results will follow.
